Components / Prompt Input

Speech Input

Push-to-talk. Ships the web original's caller-supplied-transcriber contract as the ONLY contract, so no speech dependency lands in anyone's install graph. Disabled when no engine is wired; only final transcripts fire.

  • v0.2.1
  • component
  • nativewind
  • uniwind
  • runs in Expo Go

Install

npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/nativewind/speech-input.json
npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add https://rnraielements.com/r/uniwind/speech-input.json
